packages.name: Base map
packages.desc: Land, lakes and rivers of the whole globe (Natural Earth, public domain) and the map engine (MapLibre GL JS)

packages.name: Ancient world
packages.desc: Coastlines of the periods, empires and Roman provinces at several dates, names of regions and peoples, roads, aqueducts, frontier walls, canals, city outlines (Ancient World Mapping Center, ODbL)

packages.name: Ancient places
packages.desc: The Pleiades gazetteer (CC BY 3.0): about 40,000 places with their Greek and Latin names – needed to find the places of a text

packages.name: Landscape – detailed
packages.desc: Coasts and lakes as exact as OpenStreetMap (edited by the Ancient World Mapping Center, ODbL), rivers and modern borders without simplification – for zooming in close (the base map is simplified)
